synth.notes: Twin cyan 4x4 blocks move 4px: A1/A2 up/down; A3 apart / A4 together mirrored about x=32. A move lands only if destination cells are floor colour 5 in rows 1-62. Click on an inactive 2x2 marker (9) arms: blocks recolour to players (1) and that marker activates (11); click on a player disarms. While armed, A1-A4 move the active marker's enclosing 4x4 cell (marker pos -1) unmirrored; A5 and other clicks are no-ops. HUD: colour-0 bars grow from right of row 0 and left of row 63, width round(64a/150) of the action count a, recovered across the level reset via a 16-frame memo of returned frames.
